name: Doctrine
source: docs/auth.md · AGENTS.md (parallel-agent rules) · docs/MISSION-MAP-INTERFACE.md · orders.log ORD-016
note: The rules every capsule on the ledger is governed by. Each row cites the document it comes from; nothing here is paraphrased beyond the source.

rows.label: append-only
rows.note: append through appendReceipt; never hand-edit or rewrite a stream (AGENTS.md)

rows.label: approvals
rows.note: timmy approve <planHash>; an agent never self-approves (AGENTS.md)

rows.label: staging
rows.note: never git add -A; leave other agents' work alone (AGENTS.md)

rows.label: fork
rows.note: a store fork is disclosed: FROZEN marker, fork.attest in root, evidence re-sealed citing the copies (ORD-016)

rows.label: seal
rows.note: store-pin preflight; never from a subdirectory

rows.label: no second scheduler
rows.note: every transition goes through the allowlisted controller (MISSION-MAP-INTERFACE)

rows.label: plan hash
rows.note: a capsule whose hash differs from the approved hash reads needs_approval

rows.label: isolation
rows.note: the map requests docker or host-ephemeral, never overrides

rows.label: blocked
rows.note: the unified enum for anything that cannot run

rows.label: colour
rows.note: tamper is a human-world event and stays orange (tokens)
